invariants.name: single canonical state owner
invariants.statement: During a tick exactly one Engine instance owns and mutates canonical static/dynamic state.

invariants.name: exact tick ordering
invariants.statement: Control, event, demand, routing, flow, agent, invariant and metrics phases preserve the declared baseline order.

invariants.name: exact agent and queue mass
invariants.statement: Generated, queued, active, completed and failed vehicle tokens close exactly for every tick.

invariants.name: route legality
invariants.statement: Every emitted route and movement follows directed-link and turn legality including ramps and closures.

invariants.name: cache invalidation
invariants.statement: Topology, incident, cost and policy generations invalidate exactly the dependent routing caches.

invariants.name: deterministic RNG
invariants.statement: Rust consumes named RNG streams in the same order as the frozen oracle or an explicitly versioned replacement.

invariants.name: checkpoint identity
invariants.statement: Checkpoint/restore reproduces state, RNG, caches, scheduler and replay digest exactly.

invariants.name: static topology parity
invariants.statement: Stable IDs, exact-mm geometry, layers, legal transitions, DCEL faces and area conservation match the accepted static authority.

invariants.name: dtype and unit contract
invariants.statement: Every state field has a fixed dtype, unit, bounds and overflow policy.

invariants.name: no silent fallback
invariants.statement: An explicitly selected/default Rust engine never silently executes Python, JAX, Torch or CUDA.

invariants.name: thread-count replay
invariants.statement: Canonical outputs and digests are identical at 1, 2, 4 and 8 Rust threads.

invariants.name: deterministic reductions
invariants.statement: Floating reductions use fixed partitions and stable combine order; unordered parallel reductions are absent from authority paths.

invariants.name: panic containment
invariants.statement: Rust panics never unwind across FFI; invalid inputs return typed Python errors and leave state unchanged.

invariants.name: spatial queue parity
invariants.statement: The Rust engine implements both point_queue_v1 and spatial_queue_v1 before default promotion.

invariants.name: temporal cadence
invariants.statement: Demand, event, routing refresh, land-use and policy updates preserve their declared tick/multirate cadence.

invariants.name: coarse FFI
invariants.statement: The default engine path exposes coarse Engine calls and performs no per-entity FFI.

invariants.name: no list bridge
invariants.statement: The Rust-default path contains no ndarray.tolist or Python-list staging for numeric state.

invariants.name: ordered ragged layout
invariants.statement: Routes and variable-length records cross boundaries as offsets plus flat values with validated monotonic offsets.

invariants.name: Python frontend boundary
invariants.statement: Default stepping has no Python loops over links, turns, candidates or agents.

invariants.name: Rust required CI
invariants.statement: Required CI builds Rust, runs cargo tests and executes Python/Rust parity without skip.

invariants.name: explicit thread budget
invariants.statement: The engine owns a fixed Rayon pool and records thread count; global pool dependence is forbidden.

invariants.name: no oversubscription
invariants.statement: Rust, BLAS and GPU execution do not create uncontrolled nested worker pools.

invariants.name: snapshot noninterference
invariants.statement: Snapshot/UI/report export cannot mutate state or change subsequent replay.

invariants.name: performance evidence completeness
invariants.statement: Speed claims include build/warmup, copy, steady runtime, peak RSS, workload and Python wall share.

invariants.name: GPU persistent residency
invariants.statement: Any admitted GPU kernel keeps required arrays device-resident across a chunk and reports synchronization/copy counts.

invariants.name: GPU optionality
invariants.statement: GPU dependencies are lazy and absence does not impair Rust CPU engine correctness.

invariants.name: Python oracle preservation
invariants.statement: The Python oracle remains runnable until final audit and is not edited to fit Rust output.

invariants.name: artifact schema parity
invariants.statement: Public snapshots, summaries, telemetry and benchmark artifacts preserve schema or use an explicit version migration.

invariants.name: memory boundedness
invariants.statement: Repeated chunk execution and snapshot cycles do not produce unbounded Rust/Python/GPU memory growth.

invariants.name: fresh-context closure
invariants.statement: Every implementation PR has an audit-only fresh-context receipt with P0=0, P1=0 and no unresolved specification.
